memory.help: OPTIONAL: Total memory for the job. If you leave this empty, 40G is used.

Walltime.help: OPTIONAL: Time the job needs. If you leave this empty, 2 hours is used. GPU and PVC jobs are limited to 48 hours.

gpuMonitorEnable.help: Collect NVIDIA GPU utilization/memory usage in the background while the job runs, viewable as a live chart under Manage. Not available for PVC.
